designationHistory.name: Tybee Migratory Bird Refuge
designationHistory.indexText: President Franklin D. Roosevelt established the Tybee Migratory Bird Refuge by Executive Order 7882 on May 9, 1938, as a breeding area for migratory birds.

designationHistory.indexOriginal: Tybee National Wildlife Refuge (NWR) was established on May 9, 1938, by Executive Order No. 7882, as a breeding area for migratory birds and other wildlife, and to "effectuate further the purposes of the Migratory Bird Conservation Act." The majority of the refuge is covered with sand deposits from the U.S.
